text:
liam_procurement: Heads up — AuroraTech just told us H100 shipment for us-west-2 slipped ~3w and 8 units out of 24 flagged DOA. Need RMA + shortfall plan. Anyone available for quick routing/loaner discussion?

marta_infra: Ugh. Which lot/PO? We had 10 pinned to production pool in us-west-2.

liam_procurement: PO 2026-0034, all allocated to prod us-west-2. Aurora offered replacements but they'd want expedited air fee option; also offered some temporary loaners from EU pool.

jing_vendor_ops: From Aurora: we can send 4 loaner units immediately (EU pool) and air-expedite replacements for the DOAs at +$1,200/unit. RMA process requires serials, DOA photos, and signed RM-1512 form. We can generate AWBs after we receive photos.

nikhil_sre: Can we run critical workloads on loaners? Network/team can re-route, but we need at least 6 units to avoid svc degradation for model infer. Loaners help but need customs clearance timing.

marta_infra: We can shift some non-prod to loaners and keep prod on remaining capacity, but we need HS code for customs on the loaners (and any return AWB). @liam_procurement confirm HS?

liam_procurement: Confirmed HS code 847130 (computing machines). I'll attach commercial invoice and PO ref. Aurora also asked for export control doc—they said it's standard but not mandatory for intra-EU to US air. I'll double-check.

rma-bot: RMA ticket created: RM-98321 — tracker https://rma.auroratech.com/98321. Status: awaiting serials & photos.

liam_procurement: I'll try to get vendor to absorb expedite fees. If they push back, propose we approve expedite for 4 units to hit 75% capacity and accept sea for the rest.

marta_infra: Need serials for the 8 DOA to release AWBs for return. @jing_vendor_ops can you push serials + photos by EOD?

jing_vendor_ops: Pushing to Aurora now. Photos and serials expected within 90m. They propose partial air for 4 units, sea for 4 (3w delay) to reduce cost exposure.

nikhil_sre: Sea -> too long for prod. If we pay for 4 expedited units we stabilize most jobs. What’s final cost delta including brokerage/insurance?

liam_procurement: Air expedite: $1,200/unit + est $300/unit brokerage & insurance = ~$1.5k/unit. Sea: $200/unit + ~100 brokerage = ~$300/unit but +3w leadtime.

marta_infra: Ops ask: can we temporarily route latency-critical traffic to eu-west edge (use loaners there) while replacements transit? That needs product sign-off but is feasible.

liam_procurement: Decision call: approve paying expedite for 4 units (to be pulled from PO contingencies). I'll push Aurora to cover loaner transit & RMA freight for returns. RMA docs due by 12:00 UTC tomorrow.

marta_infra: I'll start staging loaners and prepare routing changes. Will post notes for oncall and runbook updates.

jing_vendor_ops: Aurora confirmed they’ll send serials/photos shortly and will open AWBs once we sign RM-1512. They accepted vendor funding for loaner transit; expedite fee negotiation still open for replacements.

rma-bot: AWB generated for DOA return: AWB-ETD-44872. RM-98321 updated — awaiting signed RM-1512.

liam_procurement: I'll attach signed RM-1512 and updated PO by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

marta_infra: Thx — will update infra-schedules and alert oncall. :white_check_mark:
